target: Archive every physical rollout segment of one top-level Codex conversation and recover the observed item_completed visible-message envelope without weakening exact historical waterlines.
invariants: Raw Codex rollout files and existing archive records remain immutable.
All physical segments of one parent session remain one top-level conversation.
Legacy single-file message identities and cursor paths remain stable.
Subagent exclusion, summary triggers, cloud protocol, and daily-report content remain unchanged.
A freshness timestamp never substitutes for per-source coverage.
allowed_changes: Key source cursors and token ledgers by physical rollout segment.
Normalize the observed item_completed UserMessage and AgentMessage envelope.
Backfill retained affected sources once using a persisted format marker.
Aggregate segment telemetry to one conversation for user-facing metrics.
Add multi-segment and envelope regression coverage.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite or delete any rollout, raw archive record, or completed summary.
Split one parent session into multiple dashboard conversations.
Import hidden reasoning or unrestricted tool output.
Treat the latest archive timestamp as proof that every retained source is covered.
Manually patch a generated daily report instead of repairing Capture Core.

original_triggers: Continuation rollout filenames used a physical segment UUID distinct from parent session metadata.
The observed item_completed visible-message envelope was not normalized by the legacy adapter.

failure_escalation.first_failure: Stop the failing stage, preserve evidence, and repair only Capture Core or its shared cursor schema.
failure_escalation.after_limit: Do not install or publish; report the remaining blocker.
